sections.body: SIO 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting is committed at Sheraton Centre Toronto (Feb 24, 2027 – Feb 28, 2027). The principal housing is not available to Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown.

sections.title: Potential hotel business
sections.body: Future-cycle account development and/or separately evidenced overflow only — not the committed principal housing.

sections.title: Why this hotel
sections.body: Conditional small-group delegate/speaker/company lodging or SIO-approved ancillary meeting; no published overflow requirement or room-volume opportunity. Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown cannot realistically win the committed 2027 principal housing; Event scale (~900) is compatible with a 157-room hotel and ~11,000 sq ft of meeting space.

sections.title: Why now
sections.body: Competitor commitment confirmed at Sheraton Centre Toronto; develop the organizer relationship for a future cycle or residual overflow lodging.

sections.title: Who to contact
sections.body: Lindsay McSwain — SIO 2027 Event Lead; Events Coordinator in staff directory (Society of Interventional Oncology). Entry point only; lodging authority not verified.

sections.title: Recommended next step
sections.body: Contact the relevant housing representative to establish whether overflow accommodation or a secondary room block is needed for Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown. Competitor booking is confirmed at Sheraton Centre Toronto — do not request an RFP as host.

Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown cannot realistically win the committed 2027 principal housing; Convention-scale event (~5000 attendees); realistic role for a 157-room Harbourfront hotel is delegate/speaker overflow, VIP lodging and side functions — not primary housing.

sections.body: Competitor commitment confirmed at Hilton Toronto; develop the organizer relationship for a future cycle or residual overflow lodging.

sections.title: Recommended next step
sections.body: Contact the relevant housing representative to establish whether overflow accommodation or a secondary room block is needed for Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown. Competitor booking is confirmed at Hilton Toronto — do not request an RFP as host.
